import sys
sys.path.insert(0,'tmp')
import comp
raw=open('data.txt','rb').read()
data=bytes(raw)
toks=comp.find_greedy(data,2)
toks2=list(toks)+[('l',0)]
(out,err),bits=comp.encode_tokens(toks2)
print('err',err)
print('ntok',len(toks2),'nbits',len(bits),'nbytes',len(out) if out else None)
open('data.comp','wb').write(out)
print('wrote data.comp')
